_meta.note: Food additives by INS number. `origin_by_ins` records the commonly documented source/origin of selected additives for label interpretation; it is not a safety or legal-permission classification. The official FSSAI regulation lists additive identity/specification, but approval is conditional on the permitted food category and maximum use level. `status` therefore remains CONDITIONAL until those use-level conditions are entered for each food category. Review this data against later FSSAI amendments before production use.
_meta.source: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, official regulations index accessed 29 Sep 2026: https://www.fssai.gov.in/cms/food-safety-and-standards-regulations.php
